static_traits.name: 张一航
static_traits.medical_history: without重大身体疾病史；过去not yet接受过心理治疗；此前not yet经历类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 配合度高，态度积极，表达清晰，能进行自我Reflection，思路连贯

basic_info.main_problem: 因为我最喜欢的Actor罗伯特·德尼罗主演的新电影票房not佳，我觉得自己是个糟糕的粉丝，这让我感到压力和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: 我想理解为什么会有这种感受，并找到应对压力与Self-doubt的方法，让自己感觉好起来、重新享受生活。

core_beliefs: 我是一个糟糕的（not够忠诚的）粉丝
我的价值取决于我是否能让喜爱Actor的作品取得成功

special_situations.event: 电影上映后票房not佳、评论口碑偏差
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我喜爱的Actor作品失败，就说明我not够忠诚、have not尽到支持的责任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Supports by going to movies, discussing with friends, and posting on social media, to prove one's loyalty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这It is all my fault；我是个坏粉丝；我让德尼罗失望了

special_situations.event: 看到媒体上的差评或听到他人对该电影的批评
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人批评作品，就意味着我做得not够、我作为粉丝not合格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 硬撑着忽视情绪继续过日常而not去处理（push through）
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough/not够忠诚，我应该做得更多

special_situations.event: At work, thoughts drift to a movie's box office and reviews; attention is drawn to related information
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有电影成功我才算尽责，否则我就是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复自我检视是否尽到粉丝责任，沉溺于自责思考
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我辜负了他，I am a failure

special_situations.event: 进行原本喜欢的冲浪活动时想起电影表现而心情下降
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 当作品not成功时，我not配享受生活乐趣
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 降低对兴趣活动的投入，带着内疚情绪进行活动

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可为忠诚、有价值的粉丝
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被视为not忠或not够好，担心not良结果被归咎于自己
defense_goal: 通过自责与自我要求来维持忠诚感与控制感，减轻not确定与Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、可能让偶像失望的粉丝
object_relations.object_representation: 他人/媒体是苛刻的评判者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当看到电影的差评、票房not佳消息，或被人谈及影片表现时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将外界评价等同于对自身忠诚的negate，认为电影失败与自己有关
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责、低调的语气，频繁以“I am not good enough/我应该做得更多”为句式表达，减少为自己辩护，主动承担责任并表达内疚。

manifestations: Believes one should do more to support the film, and views box-office performance as a personal responsibility
在面对外界批评时增加自我约束与责任感
outcomes: 难以享受兴趣活动（如冲浪）

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 反复use“我应该做得更多”来评价自己
将“好粉丝”标准直接等同于是否能让作品成功

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 频繁Self-doubt与自责（例如“我是坏粉丝”）
在工作与兴趣活动中被内在自我批评占据，难以投入

positive_force: 能够识do not并讨论自动化思维，愿意尝试替代视角
Has already taken supportive actions (watching the film, discussing with friends, posting on social media)
Relatively stable work, with a basic life structure
negative_force: 灾难化、个人化、过度概括与“应该”句式的认知偏差
将自我价值与偶像作品成败绑定，过度寻求外部验证
对批评高度敏感，容易引发内疚与Self-doubt
高期待导致自责与Low mood，影响工作与休闲

target_behavior.behavior: 在面对对喜爱Actor作品的负面评价时出现强烈自责与压力
antecedent: 接触到关于影片表现的消息或讨论
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalizes external evaluation and demands of the self with 'should', binding loyalty to self-worth and seeking external validation
target_behavior.function: 通过自责与获得控制感来逃避not确定与Anxiety，维持被认可的忠诚形象
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood与Self-doubt worsens，工作分心，难以享受兴趣活动（如冲浪）
